conbody.p: X-Author for Excel provides the utility Show X-Author Tabs.exe to re-enable the X-Author add-in in Microsoft Excel after errors have disabled it. This ensures that the add-in will always be enabled when opening Excel after the utility is run. When you install X-Author for Excel, the diagnostic utility is installed in the same directory. A shortcut for Show X-Author Tabs.exe is also created on the desktop.
You must have administrator rights in the system where you want to run the diagnostic tool.
